title: Qman DirectPath target integration map
description: Detached governance artifact binding the portable DirectPath contract to one exact target-code revision C and one later evidence revision E without Git-hash self-reference or automatic transfer of implementation/qualification status.
x-qmanInteroperableIntegerRange: Every JSON numeric integer is in -9007199254740991..9007199254740991; wider counters use schema-defined decimal strings.
x-qmanSemanticValidationRules: Recompute sourceContract.sha256 from the exact CANONICAL-JSON-V1 portable contract bytes and reject mismatch.
The ordered mappings array is the complete mappingSurface derivation for the pinned contract revision; reject any missing, duplicate, reordered, or extra contract item.

Resolve every code/symbol/test-runner target binding only against targetRepository.commit (C). Resolve scenarios, execution results, reports, qualification indexes, and other completion evidence only against evidenceRepository.commit (E). A path cannot silently change repository authority.

scenarioBindingDigest is the detached mapping-core digest M: SHA-256 of CANONICAL-JSON-V1 over a stable projection with mapDigest=null, scenarioBindingDigest=null, evidenceRepository=null, approvals=[], trustPolicy.catalogRollbackAnchor=null, statusAxes={PORTABLE_SPEC_READY:true,TARGET_CODE_MAPPED:true,PRODUCT_IMPLEMENTED:false,QUALIFIED:false}, every completionEvidence field=null, every mappings[*].targetTestBindings=[], CURRENT_RELEASE_REQUIRED implementationStatus=NOT_STARTED, and future deferred status retained. M covers source contract, C, pre-existing trust-root/key-ring policy identity, structural target/transition/conflict/defer bindings, but never E or the post-catalog rollback anchor A. Qualification records, E4 evidence and SupportedCatalog bind C+M; after catalog verification the independent authority advances A; the anchor receipt is then copied into the qualification index before forming evidence revision E. No blob in E embeds E itself. The detached final map binds C+M+E+A. This prevents M -> records -> catalog -> A -> M.

mapDigest is SHA-256 of CANONICAL-JSON-V1 over the detached final map with mapDigest=null and approvals=[], retaining M, E, reports and complete targetTestBindings. Every approval.evidenceHash equals mapDigest. The final map is stored as DETACHED_NOT_IN_C_OR_E (or an unreferenced governance revision) and never as a blob whose repository revision it embeds.

The only legal construction graph is C -> M -> qualification/evidence content and SupportedCatalog -> externally committed catalog anchor A -> evidence revision E -> detached final map/approvals. Ordinary scenarios and reports bind C+M; only the anchor-aware qualification release index may mirror A before E is committed. No blob stored at E may embed E itself, M may not embed E or A, and the final map may not be stored in C or E.

Recompute every completion-evidence and approval artifact hash. A runtime approval role must authenticate through the trusted key ring. A future-track deferDecision is instead a portable scope declaration: product-decisions.json plus the exact decision ID is transitively hash-bound by the portable contract closure and later covered by the TARGET_ARCHITECT signature over mapping core M; it is not a self-declared trust-key role.

Completion trust is rooted out of band: when any completion axis is true, the evaluator requires an independently provisioned trust-root digest and external rollback-anchor state; values declared only by this map or its target repository cannot bootstrap their own authority. Root-signature quorum and allowed signing keys come only from the verificationPolicy inside the externally pinned root set; the map has no quorum selector.

TARGET_ARCHITECT, SECURITY and TEST approvals must have three distinct keyIds and three distinct identities; PRODUCT_RELEASE remains a separately attributable approval. A key carrying incompatible roles is invalid even if every signature verifies.
TARGET_CODE_MAPPED, PRODUCT_IMPLEMENTED, and QUALIFIED may advance only through this schema plus the repository release evaluator; boolean edits alone have no authority.

A BOUND TRANSITION item must carry transitionExecutionBinding: exact ordered operations/logical actors, durable intent, compared versions, one same-transaction write set/outbox, success/failure authoritative states, compensation transitions, and crash scenarios.

Every mapping.verificationRequirementDigest equals the const digest in its ordered prefix item and the matching source contract verificationMatrix row. Recompute each row digest over CANONICAL-JSON-V1 with requirementDigest omitted; target test bindings and scenario claims cannot alter requirements.

oneOf.x-qmanNoSelfReferenceRule: Blobs at E may bind target code C and mapping core M, but no blob at E contains evidenceRepository.commit, final mapDigest, or the commit/revision of a repository that contains that blob.

approvals.x-qmanSeparationOfDutiesRule: The semantic validator resolves each approval.keyId in the trusted ring, requires approval.identity to byte-equal key.principalId, and rejects reuse of keyId, publicKeyBase64Url or principalId across TARGET_ARCHITECT, SECURITY and TEST. It also rejects one principal/key carrying incompatible roles.

identity.description: Must byte-equal principalId of the trusted key-ring entry selected by keyId; it is not a self-asserted display name.

concreteFromStates.x-qmanSetOrder: portable stateMachines order, filtered by the transition's exact from-state or pseudoStateExpansion

transitionExecutionBinding.x-qmanDigestRule: Set bindingDigest to sha256 of the CANONICAL-JSON-V1 object with bindingDigest omitted. The semantic evaluator derives operation order/actors/states/reasons from the pinned portable contract and rejects mismatches.
transitionExecutionBinding.x-qmanPseudoStateRule: fromState preserves the portable transition expression. concreteFromStates must equal its singleton concrete state, or the exact state-machine pseudoStateExpansions entry when fromState begins ANY_; target code must bind every concrete state and no others.
transitionExecutionBinding.x-qmanOperationAuthorityRule: Every HOST_SIDE_EFFECT or EXTERNAL_PROCESS step has a non-null requiredLeaseTypeOrNull. Release stop/teardown/backend-release/clean-proof/lease-revoke steps require RELEASE and requiredReleaseGuard=true; the guard-acquire step itself requires RELEASE with requiredReleaseGuard=false. Pure planning/observation steps use null unless they intentionally read under an already-held workflow authority. The semantic validator derives and checks the exact value from the transition/workflow and operation envelope.

contractItemId.description: Must equal the parent mapping.contractItemId and be independently eligible under the frozen verification matrix; scenario self-declaration alone is not coverage authority.

deferDecision.x-qmanPortableDeferRule: Resolve authorityPath as contracts/product-decisions.json from the portable normative source closure, require raw hash authoritySha256, select exactly one ACCEPTED record whose id equals authorityDecisionId, and require its decision to explicitly place IOMMUFD/cdev in a future separately qualified profile. approvalEvidenceHash equals authoritySha256. This authorizes only the portable CURRENT-versus-FUTURE scope partition; it grants no target implementation or release authority. When TARGET_CODE_MAPPED becomes true, the distinct TARGET_ARCHITECT map approval signs M including every deferDecision. PRODUCT_ARCHITECTURE is intentionally not a runtime trust-key role.
